metas.name: Indonesia  - Dragon Snake
metas.note: In Wajo Regency you can also sometimes find gable ornaments in the shape of a snake-like dragon with a raised head.

metas.name: Indonesia - Breaking Wave
metas.note: This roof ornament with an upward curling shape, resembling a breaking wave, is exclusive to South Sulawesi, and specifically to Wajo Regency.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Indonesia - Buffalo Horns
metas.note: Buffalo horn roof ornaments have a similar distribution to ‘winged’ gable horns but are notably more common in South East Sulawesi and West Sulawesi.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Indonesia - Crossed Bars
metas.note:
Crossed roof ornaments all along the ridge of the roof are found on Nias Island.

Please note that crossed bars can also be found elsewhere—for example, in Kalimantan on the so-called "Bubungan Tinggi" chief's house. This example involves the "rabbit ear" variant appearing multiple times on the same roof.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Indonesia - Dagger
metas.note: On Rote Island you can find this roof ornament, which resembles a dagger amidst two upward-curving horns.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Indonesia - Dayak Horns
metas.note: Recognisable by their curved shape and particularly elaborate style, these gable horns are mostly found in North Kalimantan and East Kalimantan, which have the largest Dayak populations.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Indonesia - Fighting Roosters
metas.note: On Selayar Island you can find gable horns consisting of crossed rooster heads, sometimes also with little figures of people alongside.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Indonesia - Floral Antlers
metas.note: These gable horns with rich floral patterns that resemble antlers are found mostly in Riau and on the Riau Islands. These gable horns will often be seen accompanied by similar floral decorations on the gable itself.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Indonesia - Gable Ornaments
metas.note: This roof ornament is characterised by its intricate foliate design and its composition of three parts: one vertical and two along the sides of the roof. It is present in West Sulawesi, as well as South Kalimantan.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Indonesia - Jambi Hooks
metas.note: In Jambi, you can find gable horns consisting of two hooks with downward-pointing ends.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Indonesia - Rabbit Ears
metas.note: These elongated and ornate ‘rabbit ear’ gable horns are found in South Kalimantan.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Indonesia - Spear
metas.note: On Batam and Bintan you will often see simple, modern spear-shaped roof ornaments, usually painted gold or yellow, or more rarely white. As with the Riau gable horns, they often accompany floral gable decorations.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Indonesia - Trident
metas.note: These ornate foliate trident-shaped gable horns are found in South Kalimantan.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Indonesia - Vertical Finial
metas.note: Vertical finials are largely limited to West Sulawesi. They come in a rounded and a flat version.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Indonesia - Wings
metas.note: The ‘winged’ gable horn can be distinguished by its serrated lower edge. It is most common in South Sulawesi but can be found on much of the rest of Sulawesi and also in eastern Kalimantan.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Indonesia - X
metas.note: X-shaped horns share a similar distribution as winged gable horns, but can also sometimes be found in Jambi and on the Riau Islands.
